_comment: What a new person can turn on, and what each thing costs them to set up.
Every entry here was read off this machine rather than imagined: the
config keys exist in ~/.config/jarvis/config.json, the services exist in
services/, and each 'get' URL is the page that actually issues the key.
`secret` names the field a key lands in. The setup page NEVER reads a
secret back out -- it only ever learns whether one is set. Keys are
written to ~/.config/jarvis/, outside the repository, so a public clone
carries the catalogue and none of the credentials.

groups.title: The brain - pick at least one
groups.blurb: Jarvis needs one model provider and does not care which. All three have a free way in; none of them is required if another is ticked.

items.name: Claude bridge
items.what: Routes Jarvis through a Claude subscription you already pay for, with no metered API key. Optional - if you skip it, the hosted models below answer everything instead.

items.name: NVIDIA NIM
items.what: A free tier of hosted open models, no card required. Enough on its own: with a key here and nothing else ticked, Jarvis works.
items.hint: Sign in, open any model, and copy the key from the Get API Key button.

items.name: Google Gemini
items.what: Gemini, with a free tier that is generous for everyday use. Also enough on its own.

items.name: OpenAI / Codex
items.what: GPT models, and the Codex CLI for a second coding agent.
items.hint: Create a secret key. It is shown once -- paste it straight in.

groups.title: Voice and memory
groups.blurb: All three run on your own machine, need no account, and cost nothing. Skip them and Jarvis still answers in text.

items.name: Whisper
items.what: Turns your speech into text, on your own GPU. Nothing leaves the machine.
items.cost: Free. Wants an NVIDIA card; falls back to CPU and gets slower.

items.name: Kokoro voice
items.what: Gives Jarvis a voice, locally. No per-word charge, no account.

items.name: Ollama embeddings
items.what: Local memory search, so what Jarvis remembers about you stays on disk.

groups.title: Reaching you
groups.blurb: How Jarvis gets hold of you when you are not at the machine.

items.name: Telegram
items.what: Talk to Jarvis from your phone. Only the chat you pair is ever obeyed.
items.hint: Send /newbot to BotFather, then paste the token it gives you.

also.config.json:telegram_chat_id: Your own chat id -- Jarvis obeys only this one.

items.name: Phone calls
items.what: Jarvis can ring you, and you can ring it.

items.name: Push notifications
items.what: A notification on your phone when a long job finishes.

groups.title: Extras
groups.blurb: Bigger pieces. Each is a separate download, and none of them is required.

items.name: Fooocus
items.what: Image generation on your own GPU.
items.cost: Free. Wants a lot of VRAM.

items.name: Everything search
items.what: Instant filename search across every drive, so Jarvis can actually find your files.

items.name: Open Notebook
items.what: A local research notebook Jarvis can read from and write to.

items.name: God's Eye View
items.what: A live globe: flights, ships, satellites, earthquakes. Works with no keys at all.
